input: Customers want to know when their orders are delayed.
When my delivery is running late, I want enough notice to rearrange my schedule so I don't waste time waiting.
Send customers an SMS when their order is more than 15 minutes late.
When an order's estimated arrival time exceeds its promised arrival time by more than 900 seconds, the system must initiate an SMS notification within 60 seconds of detecting the change.
Notify customers immediately whenever their order is delayed. Never send more than one delay notification per order. Always notify customers when the estimated delivery time changes.
